concept: 汇点：三条项目线索汇聚到一个需要人作出判断的决策点

prompts.initial:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final production icon for a private desktop plugin named “决策与项目”, a read-only decision inbox and project desk. Single square app icon, not a presentation sheet.
Primary request: create a unique, immediately memorable symbol of three independent project threads converging at one human decision point. Concept: a folded waypoint. Three broad warm-ivory ribbons approach from the left at three staggered heights; their simple geometric folds elegantly converge near a single warm amber circular point in the upper-right quadrant, forming a compact open D-like emblem through negative space, without an actual letter. The mark must feel intentional and ownable rather than a generic network diagram.
Composition: centered emblem occupies about 66% of a forest-green rounded-square tile; generous consistent safe area. The green tile fills about 90% of a square canvas. Outside the tile is genuinely transparent. Balanced optical weight, bold silhouette legible at 24 pixels.
Style: exceptionally clean flat vector-like editorial brand design; precise edges; 3 or 4 large simple shapes; soft but deliberate corners. No 3D, texture, drop shadow, glossy effect or decorative outlines.
Color palette: existing app colors forest green #184D42, warm ivory #F7F8F6, single muted amber #BB8E4C. Amber should identify the decision point; green background supports light and dark host UI.
Text: none.
Avoid: lettering, words, tick marks, checkboxes, robots, brains, AI sparkles, generic chart bars, arrows, hexagonal tech badges, tiny details, a border around the whole canvas, mockup frames, multiple alternatives. Only the final icon with transparent outer corners.
prompts.flatColorRefinement: Edit this exact plugin icon. Preserve the existing three ivory converging ribbons, amber circular decision point, layout, proportions, tile silhouette and generous outer transparent corners. Only clean up the color treatment: replace the ENTIRE rounded-square tile interior with a perfectly uniform fully opaque solid forest green #184D42. There must be absolutely NO dark patches, transparent holes, shadows, gradients, lighting, texture or noise inside the tile. Make all three ribbons uniformly solid warm ivory #F7F8F6 and the circle uniformly solid muted amber #BB8E4C. Crisp smooth antialiased edges only. Transparent pixels are allowed ONLY outside the rounded square. Production flat vector-style app icon. No new objects or text.
prompts.selectedTransparentMark: Refine the provided icon into a standalone flat symbol with NO background tile. Remove the entire green rounded-square background, all shadows and all textures completely, leaving a genuine transparent canvas. Recolor the THREE existing white ribbon shapes to a single flat fully opaque deep forest green #184D42. Preserve their three-level flowing convergence geometry. Keep the single amber circular decision point, but make its fill completely uniform #BB8E4C. Only four clean solid shapes should remain: three green ribbons and one amber circle. Make the shapes a compact centered composition filling 80% of the square, with 10% transparent safe margin. Every ribbon and the amber circle must be uniformly fully opaque with crisp smooth edges. Absolutely no black, white, gray or colored background; no rounded-square tile; no gradients, shading, noise, transparent holes within the solid shapes, lettering, or extra details. This is a production sidebar logo intended to be legible at 24px.
